Direct original-complex face enumeration confirms Euler -75 and pure dimension eleven; nonzero lower homology obstructs shellability. No homotopy conclusion is asserted.

value.rationale: The unique classical pair of nonisomorphic strongly regular graphs with parameters (16,6,2,2) gives a natural testbed for whether homological graph invariants detect structure beyond numerical parameters. Here both four-cut complexes share equal reduced Euler -75, top dimension 11 and equal dual-face count 1652, while their integral homology differs in three degrees and is torsion-free. The positive lower homology also proves nonshellability. These are exact natural finite classifications, not arbitrary slices or unsupported general claims.
